prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster source for a Sega Mega Drive overhead action arena, not a concept presentation.
Create ONE complete background map for Plaguefall chapter 2A, a service street behind an intact rural church in Brazilian caatinga. Use attached image 1 as the primary style and gameplay-layout reference. Image 2 is environmental thematic reference only, do NOT reproduce its contact-sheet layout. Image 3 shows actor perspective.
Deliver a single rectangular map, exact landscape ratio 512:320 (for example 1536x960). Orthographic camera looking down at 60 degrees ABOVE ground, matching image 1 and actors, no perspective vanishing, no horizon, no diamond/isometric rotation. North wall horizontal, east/west walls vertical. The world boundaries fill the image without any margin.
Map composition measured on the intended 512x320 native map: architecture in y0..95 only; clear walkable rectangle x16..495,y96..303, at least two-thirds image calm open ochre ground. Continuous 16px-thick side walls x0..15 and x496..511 connect seamlessly to bottom wall y304..319 at both lower corners. Stone/plaster side walls cap with terracotta bricks. Bottom boundary is low straight wall; small blue service gate centered x240,y304 with same boundary thickness.
Upper left x16..190,y8..95: compact intact whitewashed chapel rear facade with terracotta roof and blue trim, tiny blue closed door, empty devotional niche indicating the Santa statue was safely removed. It must look intact, peaceful and evacuated, NOT ruined. Upper center x208..335,y32..95: empty metal provisions rack and 3 tightly packed blue water jugs against wall, small folded canvas; all entirely outside walkable floor. Upper right x400..480,y48..95: open blue service gate with red cloth marker and glimpse of caatinga beyond. Other top strip has dry scrub behind continuous pale plaster back wall.
Environmental story: empty niche, cleared provisions shelves, neat jug rings and a few faint footprints close to northern wall communicate organized evacuation. No people, no insects, no weapons, no UI, no labels, no text.
Style: richly crafted but small readable pixel art like approved map image 1, crisp individual pixel clusters, limited warm ochre/cream/terracotta/dark navy/olive palette with dark blue accents, very restrained dithering. Not painterly, not photorealistic, no film grain, no blurry contours. Economical reusable tile modules: repeated 32x32 calm sand floor with only tiny sparse pebbles; repeated wall segments; architecture crisp at target native 512px width. Avoid busy random texture, big scattered debris, interior obstacles, shadows crossing walkable center, tall lower wall. Do not show detached asset samples or contact sheets. Single full map only.
inspection: Mapa único; igreja íntegra; nicho vazio; rack sem provisões; arena limpa; paredes conectadas.
